title: Course 3: Enterprise Deployment & Offline Content Delivery (V2 Exclusive)
description: Brand new offline course bundled in Version 2.0.0. Covers automated multi-platform compilation, zero-downtime silent updates, and tamper-resistant offline storage.

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Zero-Downtime Silent Update Execution
lessons.content: Techniques for in-place binary swapping, process detachment, and relaunch without corrupting running user state.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Cross-Platform Packaging Pipelines
lessons.content: Deep dive into PyInstaller AST scanners, dynamic symbol resolution, Inno Setup scripting, and macOS DMG packaging.

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Robust Error Handling & Offline Fallbacks
lessons.content: Designing bulletproof desktop software that performs flawlessly in disconnected, air-gapped environments.
